grammar_topics.title: Adjective
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A word that modifies or describes a noun or pronoun is called an adjective.
definition.marathi: Noun किंवा Pronoun बद्दल अधिक माहिती देणाऱ्या शब्दाला Adjective म्हणतात.

examples.tag: The beautiful girl — girl बद्दल सांगते
Three boys — boys ची संख्या सांगते
This book — कोणते book ते दाखवते

cases.name: Positive Degree
cases.english: Simple form of adjective, no comparison.
cases.marathi: Adjective चे साधे रूप, कुठलीही तुलना नाही.

cases.name: Superlative Degree
cases.english: Compares more than two persons or things.
cases.marathi: दोनपेक्षा जास्त व्यक्ती किंवा वस्तूंची तुलना.

types.name: Adjective of Quality
types.english: Describes the quality or kind of a noun.
types.marathi: Noun ची गुणवत्ता किंवा प्रकार सांगते.

types.name: Adjective of Quantity
types.english: Shows how much of a thing is meant.

types.name: Adjective of Number
types.english: Shows how many persons or things are meant.

types.name: Demonstrative Adjective
types.english: Points out which person or thing is meant.
types.marathi: कोणती व्यक्ती किंवा वस्तू ते दाखवते.

types.name: Possessive Adjective
types.english: Shows possession or ownership before a noun.

types.name: Interrogative Adjective
types.english: Used with nouns to ask questions.

types.name: Distributive Adjective
types.english: Refers to each one of a number separately.

types.name: Emphasizing Adjective
types.english: Used to lay emphasis on a noun.

types.name: Exclamatory Adjective
types.english: Used with 'what' to express strong feeling.
types.marathi: What बरोबर भावना व्यक्त करण्यासाठी वापरतात.

rules.title: Comparative Degree — Between Two
rules.english: Use comparative degree when comparing exactly two persons or things. Use 'the' before comparative when comparing two.
rules.marathi: फक्त दोन व्यक्ती/वस्तूंची तुलना असेल तेव्हा Comparative Degree वापरतात.
examples: Ram is the taller of the two boys.

wrongRight.wrong: Ram is the tallest of the two boys.
wrongRight.right: Ram is the taller of the two boys.

rules.title: Superlative Degree — Among More Than Two
rules.english: Use superlative degree when comparing more than two persons or things.
rules.marathi: दोनपेक्षा जास्त व्यक्ती/वस्तूंची तुलना असेल तेव्हा Superlative Degree वापरतात.
examples: He is the best player in the team.

wrongRight.wrong: He is the better player in the team.
wrongRight.right: He is the best player in the team.

rules.title: Double Comparative / Double Superlative - Never Use Most and More with Comparative or Superlative
rules.english: Never use 'more' with a comparative form, or 'most' with a superlative form.
rules.marathi: Comparative Form बरोबर 'more' आणि Superlative Form बरोबर 'most' वापरणे चुकीचे आहे.
examples: She is more intelligent than her brother.

wrongRight.wrong: She is more smarter than her brother.
wrongRight.right: She is smarter than her brother.

wrongRight.wrong: He is the most tallest boy.

rules.title: Absolute Adjectives (No Comparison) - Circle,Unique,etc.
rules.english: Certain adjectives cannot be compared as they are already at their highest degree.
rules.marathi: काही Adjectives आधीच पूर्णतम अवस्था दर्शवतात, त्यांची तुलना करता येत नाही.

wrongRight.wrong: This is a more unique design.

rules.title: Elder / Older Rule - Family/General
rules.english: Elder is used for members of the same family; Older is used for general comparison of age.
rules.marathi: Elder फक्त एकाच कुटुंबातील सदस्यांसाठी; Older सामान्य वयाच्या तुलनेसाठी वापरतात.
examples: My elder brother is a doctor.
This building is older than that one.

rules.title: Farther / Further Rule - Physical Distance/Addition or moe, आणखी
rules.english: Farther refers to physical distance; Further means 'additional' or 'more'.
rules.marathi: Farther भौगोलिक अंतरासाठी; Further म्हणजे 'आणखी' किंवा 'अधिक' असा अर्थ.
examples: Delhi is farther from Mumbai than Pune.

wrongRight.wrong: I need further clarification about the distance.
wrongRight.right: I need farther clarification about the distance.

rules.title: Later / Latter Rule - Time / Second of Two Thing
rules.english: Later refers to time; Latter refers to the second of two things mentioned.
rules.marathi: Later वेळाशी संबंधित; Latter नुकत्याच उल्लेख केलेल्या दोनपैकी दुसऱ्याला सूचित करते.
examples: Between tea and coffee, I prefer the latter.

wrongRight.wrong: Between Sachin and Virat, the later is more aggressive.
wrongRight.right: Between Sachin and Virat, the latter is more aggressive.

rules.title: Little / A Little / The Little Rule
rules.english: Little = negligible amount (negative sense); A little = some amount (positive sense); The little = whatever small amount there is.
rules.marathi: Little = नगण्य प्रमाण (नकारात्मक); A little = थोडे (सकारात्मक); The little = जे काही थोडे आहे ते.
examples: He spent the little money he had.

wrongRight.wrong: There is little hope, so let's try.
wrongRight.right: There is a little hope, so let's try.

rules.title: Few / A Few / The Few Rule
rules.english: Few = negligible number (negative sense); A few = some number (positive sense); The few = whatever small number there is.
rules.marathi: Few = अत्यल्प संख्या (नकारात्मक); A few = काही (सकारात्मक); The few = जे काही थोडे आहेत ते.
examples: The few students who passed were rewarded.

wrongRight.wrong: Few people came to help him, so he managed.
wrongRight.right: A few people came to help him, so he managed.

rules.title: Each / Every Rule - Two or More/Three or more
rules.english: Each is used for two or more considered individually; Every is used for three or more considered collectively. Both take singular verbs.
rules.marathi: Each दोन किंवा अधिकांसाठी वैयक्तिकरीत्या; Every तीन किंवा अधिकांसाठी सामूहिकरीत्या वापरतात. दोन्हींनंतर Singular Verb येते.
examples: Each of the two boys was rewarded.
Every student must submit the assignment.

wrongRight.wrong: Every of the two boys was rewarded.
wrongRight.right: Each of the two boys was rewarded.

rules.title: Comparative — Exclude the Subject (Other / Else)
rules.english: When using comparative degree to compare a subject with others in the same group, use 'other' or 'else' to exclude the subject itself.
rules.marathi: एकाच गटातील तुलनेत स्वतःला वगळण्यासाठी 'other' किंवा 'else' वापरतात.
examples: Sachin is better than any other cricketer in India.

wrongRight.wrong: Sachin is better than any cricketer in India.
wrongRight.right: Sachin is better than any other cricketer in India.

rules.title: Superlative — Include the Subject (No 'other')
rules.english: When using superlative degree, do not use 'other' because the superlative already includes the subject in the comparison.
rules.marathi: Superlative Degree मध्ये 'other' वापरत नाहीत, कारण Superlative मध्ये स्वतः आधीच समाविष्ट असते.
examples: Sachin is the best cricketer in India.

wrongRight.wrong: Sachin is the best other cricketer in India.
wrongRight.right: Sachin is the best cricketer in India.

rules.title: No Sooner... Than Rule - Followed By than(Never when or then)
rules.english: 'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', never by 'when' or 'then'.
rules.marathi: 'No sooner' नंतर नेहमी 'than' येतो, 'when' किंवा 'then' येत नाही.
examples: No sooner did he arrive than it started raining.

wrongRight.wrong: No sooner did he arrive when it started raining.
wrongRight.right: No sooner did he arrive than it started raining.

rules.title: Adjective Placement Rule attributive/predicative
rules.english: Adjectives normally come before the noun they modify, but predicative adjectives come after a linking verb.
rules.marathi: Adjective सामान्यतः Noun च्या आधी येतो, पण Linking Verb नंतर येणारा Adjective Predicative असतो.

rules.title: This / That (Singular noun) vs These / Those (Plural noun)
rules.english: This and That are used with singular nouns; These and Those are used with plural nouns.
rules.marathi: This / That Singular Noun बरोबर; These / Those Plural Noun बरोबर वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: These kind of people are dangerous.
wrongRight.right: This kind of people is dangerous.

rules.title: Positive Degree (As...As) Rule - Always Positive Degree
rules.english: In positive degree comparison using 'as...as', use the base form of the adjective (never comparative or superlative).
rules.marathi: As...as वापरताना नेहमी Positive Degree (base form) वापरतात.
examples: She is as tall as her sister.

wrongRight.wrong: She is as taller as her sister.
wrongRight.right: She is as tall as her sister.

rules.title: Prefer... to Rule - Never Use Comparative Degree
rules.english: Use Positive Degree after 'prefer...to'. Never use comparative degree after 'prefer'.
rules.marathi: Prefer...to च्या नंतर Positive Degree वापरतात. Comparative Degree वापरत नाहीत.

wrongRight.wrong: I prefer tea more than coffee.

rules.title: Senior / Junior / Superior / Inferior Rule = to insted of than
rules.english: These Latin comparatives take 'to' instead of 'than' and cannot be used with 'more'.
rules.marathi: Senior, Junior, Superior, Inferior हे Latin Comparatives 'than' ऐवजी 'to' वापरतात आणि 'more' बरोबर येत नाहीत.
examples: This product is inferior to that one.

wrongRight.wrong: He is more senior than me.
She is junior than her colleague.
wrongRight.right: She is junior to her colleague.

rules.title: The + Comparative, The + Comparative
rules.english: When two comparative degrees are used together with 'the...the', both adjectives must be in comparative form.
rules.marathi: The...the च्या संरचनेत दोन्ही Comparative Degrees वापरतात.
examples: The harder you work, the better the results.

wrongRight.wrong: The hard you work, the better the results.
wrongRight.right: The harder you work, the better the results.

grammar_topics.title: Adverb
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: An adverb is a word that gives more information about a verb, adjective, another adverb, or a whole sentence.
definition.marathi: जो शब्द Verb, Adjective, दुसरा Adverb किंवा संपूर्ण Sentence बद्दल अधिक माहिती देतो त्याला Adverb म्हणतात.

types.name: Adverb of Manner
types.english: Shows how an action happens.

types.name: Adverb of Time
types.english: Shows when an action happens.

types.name: Adverb of Place
types.english: Shows where an action happens.

types.name: Adverb of Frequency
types.english: Shows how often an action happens.
types.marathi: क्रिया किती वेळा घडते ते सांगते.

types.name: Adverb of Degree / Quantity
types.english: Shows intensity or extent.

types.name: Adverb of Duration
types.english: Shows how long an action continues.
types.marathi: क्रिया किती वेळ चालते ते सांगते.

types.name: Adverb of Possibility
types.english: Shows possibility or certainty.

positionOfAdverbs.name: Beginning
positionOfAdverbs.english: Adverb can come at the start of a sentence.

positionOfAdverbs.name: Middle
positionOfAdverbs.english: Adverb can come between subject and main verb or after helping verb.
positionOfAdverbs.marathi: Adverb subject आणि main verb मध्ये किंवा helping verb नंतर येतो.

positionOfAdverbs.name: End
positionOfAdverbs.english: Adverb often comes at the end of the sentence.

wrongRight.wrong: He spoke yesterday politely at school.
wrongRight.right: He spoke politely at school yesterday.

interrogativeAdverbs.name: How
interrogativeAdverbs.english: Used to ask manner or method.

relativeAdverbs.name: Where
examples: This is the place where I was born.

relativeAdverbs.name: When
examples: I know the day when he arrived.

relativeAdverbs.name: Why
examples: I know the reason why he left.

confusingAdverbs.english: Hard means diligently; hardly means almost not.
confusingAdverbs.marathi: Hard म्हणजे मेहनतीने; hardly म्हणजे जवळजवळ नाही.

confusingAdverbs.english: Late means not on time; lately means recently.
confusingAdverbs.marathi: Late म्हणजे उशिरा; lately म्हणजे अलीकडे.

confusingAdverbs.english: Near means close; nearly means almost.
confusingAdverbs.marathi: Near म्हणजे जवळ; nearly म्हणजे जवळपास.

confusingAdverbs.english: High means at great height; highly means very much.
confusingAdverbs.marathi: High म्हणजे उंच; highly म्हणजे फार जास्त.

confusingAdverbs.english: Deep means physical depth; deeply means emotionally.
confusingAdverbs.marathi: Deep म्हणजे खोली; deeply म्हणजे भावनिकरीत्या.

confusingAdverbs.english: Free means without payment; freely means without restriction.
confusingAdverbs.marathi: Free म्हणजे विनामूल्य; freely म्हणजे मोकळेपणाने.

specialStructures.name: Enough Rule
specialStructures.example: He is tall enough. / Enough money

specialStructures.name: Too Rule
specialStructures.example: The tea is too hot to drink.

specialStructures.name: Very vs Too
specialStructures.example: She is very beautiful. / She is too tired to walk.

specialStructures.name: Already / Yet
specialStructures.example: I have already finished. / I haven't finished yet.

specialStructures.name: Only Position
specialStructures.formula: Meaning changes with position of only
specialStructures.example: Only Ram passed. / Ram only passed. / Ram passed only English.

negativeAdverbs.name: Negative Adverbs
negativeAdverbs.english: After negative adverbs, inversion is used.

rules.title: Adverb modifies Verb
rules.marathi: Adverb verb बद्दल अधिक माहिती देतो.

rules.title: Adverb modifies Adjective
rules.marathi: Adverb adjective ची तीव्रता दर्शवतो.

rules.title: Adverb modifies another Adverb
rules.marathi: Adverb दुसऱ्या adverb ला modify करतो.

rules.title: Adverb modifies whole Sentence
rules.marathi: Adverb संपूर्ण sentence बद्दल माहिती देतो.

rules.title: Frequency before Main Verb
rules.marathi: Frequency adverb main verb च्या आधी येतो.

rules.title: Frequency after Be Verb
rules.marathi: Frequency adverb be verb नंतर येतो.

rules.title: Manner → Place → Time
rules.marathi: Adverbs चा order Manner, Place, Time असा असतो.
examples: He spoke politely at school yesterday.

rules.title: Enough Rule
rules.marathi: Enough adjective नंतर आणि noun आधी येतो.

rules.title: Too Rule
rules.marathi: Too म्हणजे गरजेपेक्षा जास्त.
examples: The tea is too hot to drink.

rules.title: Already / Yet
rules.marathi: Already affirmative मध्ये, yet negative किंवा question मध्ये वापरतात.

rules.title: Negative Adverbs + Inversion
rules.marathi: Negative adverbs नंतर inversion वापरतात.

rules.title: Double Negative
rules.marathi: Double negative वापरू नये.

rules.title: Adverb vs Adjective
rules.marathi: Adjective noun बद्दल आणि adverb verb बद्दल माहिती देतो.

rules.title: Common SSC Error: good vs well
rules.marathi: Verb नंतर adverb वापरतात.

rules.title: Common SSC Error: beautiful vs beautifully
rules.marathi: Verb नंतर adverb form वापरतात.

rules.title: Common SSC Error: late vs lately
rules.marathi: Late आणि lately चा अर्थ वेगळा असतो.

grammar_topics.title: Article
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: An Article is a word placed before a noun to indicate whether the noun is specific or non-specific. Articles are considered a type of adjective because they modify nouns.
definition.marathi: Noun पूर्वी येऊन त्या Noun बद्दल विशिष्ट (Specific) किंवा सामान्य (General) माहिती देणाऱ्या शब्दांना Article म्हणतात.

types.name: Indefinite Article (A / An)
types.english: Used for any one person, place or thing.
types.marathi: एखाद्या सामान्य (Non-Specific) व्यक्ती, वस्तू किंवा स्थळासाठी वापरतात.

types.name: Definite Article (The)
types.english: Used for a particular or specific noun.
types.marathi: विशिष्ट व्यक्ती, वस्तू किंवा स्थळासाठी वापरतात.

goldenConcept.title: SSC Golden Concept: Sound vs Alphabet
goldenConcept.english: Article usage depends on the pronunciation (sound), not the alphabet the word starts with.
goldenConcept.marathi: Article हा Alphabet वर नाही तर Sound (उच्चार) वर अवलंबून असतो.

tables.title: SSC Exceptions: Without Article vs With Article
Few / A Few / Little / A Little

rules.title: Use A - Consonant Sound
rules.english: Use A before words beginning with a consonant sound.
rules.marathi: व्यंजनाच्या उच्चाराने सुरू होणाऱ्या शब्दांपूर्वी A वापरतात.

rules.title: Use AN - Vowel Sound
rules.english: Use An before words beginning with a vowel sound.
rules.marathi: स्वराच्या उच्चाराने सुरू होणाऱ्या शब्दांपूर्वी An वापरतात.

rules.title: A/An = One
rules.english: A / An means 'one'.
rules.marathi: A किंवा An चा अर्थ एक असा होतो.

rules.title: Never With Plural Noun
rules.english: A/An is never used before plural nouns.
rules.marathi: Plural Noun पूर्वी A किंवा An वापरत नाहीत.

rules.title: Never With Uncountable Nouns
rules.english: A/An is not used before uncountable nouns.
rules.marathi: Uncountable Noun पूर्वी A किंवा An वापरत नाहीत.

rules.title: Silent H -> Use AN
rules.english: If H is silent, use AN.
rules.marathi: H चा उच्चार होत नसेल तर An वापरतात.

rules.title: Sound of YU -> Use A
rules.english: Words beginning with vowel letters but consonant sound (/juː/) take A.
rules.marathi: Vowel letter असला तरी उच्चार 'यु' असल्यास A वापरतात.

rules.title: Words Beginning With One
rules.english: One begins with /w/ sound.
rules.marathi: One चा उच्चार 'वन' असल्यामुळे A वापरतात.

rules.title: Words Beginning With O But Consonant Sound
rules.english: If O has a consonant sound, use A.
rules.marathi: O ने सुरुवात झाली तरी स्वराचा उच्चार नसल्यास A वापरतात.

rules.title: Abbreviations
rules.english: Use the article according to the pronunciation of the first letter.
rules.marathi: Short Form (Abbreviation) मध्ये पहिल्या अक्षराच्या उच्चारानुसार Article वापरतात.

rules.title: Before Adjective + Noun
rules.english: Article depends on the pronunciation of the adjective, not the noun.
rules.marathi: Article हा Noun वर नाही तर आधी आलेल्या Adjective च्या उच्चारावर ठरतो.

rules.title: Before Profession
rules.english: Use A/An before professions.
rules.marathi: Profession किंवा Occupation पूर्वी A/An वापरतात.

rules.title: Before Singular Countable Noun
rules.english: A singular countable noun generally requires an article.
rules.marathi: Singular Countable Noun पूर्वी Article आवश्यक असतो.

rules.title: Exclamatory Sentences
rules.english: Use A/An after What or Such with singular countable nouns.
rules.marathi: What किंवा Such नंतर Singular Countable Noun आल्यास A/An वापरतात.

rules.title: Rate / Price / Speed
rules.english: A/An is used to express rate.
rules.marathi: Rate, Price, Speed दाखवताना A वापरतात.

rules.title: Previously Mentioned Noun
rules.english: Use The when the noun has already been mentioned.
rules.marathi: एकदा उल्लेख केलेल्या Noun साठी पुन्हा The वापरतात.
examples: I saw a dog. The dog was barking.

rules.title: Unique Things
rules.english: Use The before things that are unique.
rules.marathi: जगात एकच असलेल्या गोष्टींसमोर The वापरतात.

rules.title: Superlative Degree
rules.english: The is always used before Superlative Degree.
rules.marathi: Superlative Degree पूर्वी नेहमी The येतो.

rules.title: Ordinal Numbers
rules.english: Use The before ordinal numbers.
rules.marathi: First, Second, Third... पूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Musical Instruments
rules.english: Use The before the names of musical instruments.
rules.marathi: वाद्यांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Holy / Religious Books
rules.english: Use The before religious books.
rules.marathi: धार्मिक ग्रंथांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Newspapers
rules.english: Use The before newspapers.
rules.marathi: वृत्तपत्रांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Rivers
rules.english: Use The before rivers.
rules.marathi: नद्यांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Oceans & Seas
rules.english: Use The before oceans and seas.
rules.marathi: महासागर व समुद्रांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Mountain Ranges
rules.english: Use The before mountain ranges.
rules.marathi: पर्वतरांगांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Deserts
rules.english: Use The before deserts.
rules.marathi: वाळवंटांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Group of Islands
rules.english: Use The before groups of islands.
rules.marathi: बेटांच्या समूहापूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Directions
rules.english: Use The when direction indicates a region.
rules.marathi: Direction प्रदेश दर्शवत असल्यास The वापरतात.

rules.title: Adjective Representing Whole Class
rules.english: The + Adjective = Entire Class.
rules.marathi: The + Adjective म्हणजे त्या वर्गातील सर्व लोक.

rules.title: Nationality
rules.english: Use The before nationality representing the whole nation.
rules.marathi: संपूर्ण राष्ट्र दर्शवताना The वापरतात.

rules.title: Inventions
rules.english: Use The before inventions.
rules.marathi: शोध/आविष्कारांसमोर The वापरतात.

rules.title: Whole Species
rules.english: The + Singular Noun represents the whole species.
rules.marathi: एकाच Noun द्वारे संपूर्ण जातीचा उल्लेख.
examples: The tiger is a dangerous animal.

rules.title: Proper Noun With Description
rules.english: Use The when a Proper Noun is qualified.
rules.marathi: Proper Noun बद्दल अतिरिक्त माहिती दिल्यास The वापरतात.

rules.title: Offices / Posts
rules.english: Use The before official positions.
rules.marathi: पदनामांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

wrongRight.right: The Prime Minister addressed the nation.

rules.title: Families
rules.english: The + Family Name = Entire Family.
rules.marathi: पूर्ण कुटुंब दर्शवताना The वापरतात.

rules.title: Same / Only
rules.english: Use The before Same and Only.
rules.marathi: Same आणि Only पूर्वी The येतो.

rules.title: Comparative (The...The)
rules.english: The + Comparative, The + Comparative.
examples: The more you read, the more you learn.

rules.title: Important Buildings
rules.english: Use The before famous buildings and monuments.
rules.marathi: प्रसिद्ध इमारतींपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Hotels / Cinemas / Museums
rules.english: Use The before hotels, cinemas and museums.
rules.marathi: हॉटेल्स, सिनेमा, संग्रहालयांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Ships / Trains / Aircraft
rules.english: Use The before names of ships, trains and aircraft.
rules.marathi: जहाज, ट्रेन, विमानांच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Proper Noun - Zero Article
rules.english: Do not use an article before Proper Nouns.
rules.marathi: Proper Noun पूर्वी सामान्यतः Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Languages - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before names of languages.
rules.marathi: भाषांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Academic Subjects - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before subjects.
rules.marathi: विषयांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Games & Sports - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before games.
rules.marathi: खेळांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Meals - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before meals.
rules.marathi: जेवणांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Days & Months - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before days and months.
rules.marathi: वार आणि महिन्यांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Festivals - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before festivals.
rules.marathi: सणांच्या नावांपूर्वी Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Relations - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before relations used as proper names.
rules.marathi: आई, वडील इत्यादी संबोधन म्हणून वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The father of the boy is a teacher.

rules.title: Transport (By) - Zero Article
rules.english: No article after By before means of transport.
rules.marathi: By नंतर वाहनाचे नाव आल्यास Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Fixed Phrases With By
rules.english: No article in fixed 'by' expressions.
rules.marathi: या वाक्प्रचारांमध्ये Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Home - Zero Article
rules.english: No article before Home when used as destination.
rules.marathi: Home पूर्वी सामान्यतः Article वापरत नाही.

rules.title: Bed - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when bed is used for sleeping.
rules.marathi: झोपण्यासाठी Bed वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: School - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when school is used for studying.
rules.marathi: शिकण्यासाठी School वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: I went to the school to meet the Principal.

rules.title: College - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when in college as a student.
rules.marathi: विद्यार्थी म्हणून College असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Hospital - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when admitted for treatment.
rules.marathi: उपचारासाठी Hospital असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Prison / Jail - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when someone is imprisoned.
rules.marathi: कैदेसाठी Prison वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Church / Temple / Mosque - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when used for worship.
rules.marathi: पूजेसाठी वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Market - Zero Article
rules.english: No article when market is used generally.
rules.marathi: साधारण अर्थाने Market वापरल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Man / Woman (General Sense)
rules.english: No article in a general sense.
rules.marathi: संपूर्ण मानवजातीचा उल्लेख असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Abstract Noun (General)
rules.english: No article before abstract nouns in general sense.
rules.marathi: Abstract Noun सामान्य अर्थाने वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The honesty of the boy impressed everyone.

wrongRight.wrong: The honesty is the best policy.

rules.title: Material Noun (General)
rules.english: No article before material nouns in general sense.
rules.marathi: Material Noun सामान्य अर्थाने वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The water in this bottle is dirty.

rules.title: Plural Noun (General)
rules.english: No article before plural nouns in general sense.
rules.marathi: Plural Noun सामान्य अर्थाने वापरल्यास Article नाही.
examples: The dogs in my house are friendly.

rules.title: Country Names
rules.english: Normally no article is used before country names, but THE is used for plural/union/kingdom/republic type names.
rules.marathi: देशांच्या नावांपूर्वी सामान्यतः Article वापरत नाही, पण Plural/Union/Kingdom/Republic प्रकारच्या नावांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Organizations
rules.english: Use THE before important organizations.
rules.marathi: महत्त्वाच्या संस्थांपूर्वी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Titles & Designations
rules.english: Title + Name takes no article; Title alone takes THE.
rules.marathi: Title + Name असल्यास Article नाही; फक्त Title असल्यास The वापरतात.
examples: The Prime Minister addressed the nation.

rules.title: Few / A Few
rules.english: Few means almost none (negative); A few means some (positive). Used with countable nouns.
rules.marathi: Few = जवळजवळ नाही (Negative); A few = काही आहेत (Positive). Countable Noun सोबत वापरतात.

rules.title: Little / A Little
rules.english: Little means almost none (negative); A little means some (positive). Used with uncountable nouns.
rules.marathi: Little = जवळजवळ नाही (Negative); A little = थोडे आहे (Positive). Uncountable Noun सोबत वापरतात.

rules.title: Most
rules.english: Most in a general sense takes no article; The most before a particular group.
rules.marathi: सामान्य अर्थाने Most ला Article नाही; विशिष्ट गटासाठी The most वापरतात.
examples: The most students in this class...

rules.title: Next / Last
rules.english: Next/Last as time expressions take no article; The next/last for a specific sequence.
rules.marathi: Time Expression म्हणून Next/Last ला Article नाही; विशिष्ट क्रमासाठी The next/last वापरतात.

rules.title: Number Expressions
rules.english: Use A/An before number expressions like hundred, thousand, million, dozen.
rules.marathi: Hundred, Thousand, Million, Dozen यांपूर्वी A/An वापरतात.

rules.title: Mr / Mrs / Dr
rules.english: No article before Mr, Mrs, Dr with a name.
rules.marathi: Mr, Mrs, Dr नावासोबत असल्यास Article नाही.

rules.title: Body Parts
rules.english: THE is used after many verbs/prepositions referring to body parts.
rules.marathi: Body Parts साठी अनेक Verb/Preposition नंतर The वापरतात.
examples: He hit me on the head.
She caught me by the hand.
He was wounded in the leg.

rules.title: Time Expressions
rules.english: THE is used with morning, afternoon, evening; but no article with night in general.
rules.marathi: Morning, Afternoon, Evening सोबत The वापरतात; पण Night सामान्यतः Article शिवाय.

rules.title: Means of Communication
rules.english: Use THE with phone, radio, television as means of communication.
rules.marathi: Phone, Radio, Television साठी The वापरतात.

rules.title: Whole Class (The + Singular Noun)
rules.english: The + Singular Noun can represent the whole class.
rules.marathi: The + Singular Noun संपूर्ण वर्ग दर्शवते.

pyqTraps.right: The rich should help the poor.
The Prime Minister addressed the nation.

pyqTraps.wrong: He is in the hospital (treatment sense).
The honesty is the best policy.

examStrategy.english: Focus on the Sound Rule, high-frequency words (University, Honest, Hour, European, MBA), A/An + Profession, Abbreviations, Rivers, Oceans, Mountain Ranges, Superlatives, Musical Instruments and Ordinals.
examStrategy.marathi: Sound Rule सर्वात महत्त्वाचा. University, Honest, Hour, European, MBA वर PYQs वारंवार येतात. Rivers, Oceans, Mountain Ranges, Superlatives, Musical Instruments, Ordinals नक्की revise करा.

examStrategy.english: Revise pronunciation-based exceptions, fixed expressions, nationality, species, comparative pattern, qualified proper nouns, official posts and omission rules together.
examStrategy.marathi: Pronunciation-based exceptions, Fixed Expressions, Nationality, Species, Comparative Pattern, Qualified Proper Nouns, Official Posts आणि Omission Rules एकत्र revise करा.

goldenRevision: Languages, Subjects, Games, Meals, Days, Months, Festivals -> No Article
By Bus / By Train / By Air -> No Article
Go home / Go to bed / In hospital / Go to prison -> No Article

grammar_topics.title: Conjunction
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A conjunction is a word used to join words, phrases, clauses or sentences.
definition.marathi: दोन शब्द, वाक्यांश, Clause किंवा वाक्य जोडणाऱ्या शब्दाला Conjunction म्हणतात.

examples.word: Study hard or you will fail.

types.name: Coordinating Conjunction
types.english: Joins equal words, phrases or clauses.
types.marathi: समान दर्जाचे शब्द किंवा Clause जोडते.

types.name: Subordinating Conjunction
types.english: Joins a dependent clause with an independent clause.
types.marathi: Dependent Clause ला Main Clause शी जोडते.

types.name: Correlative Conjunction
types.english: Conjunctions used in pairs.

rules.title: Both...And = Plural Verb
rules.english: Both + Noun + and + Noun always takes a plural verb.
rules.marathi: Both + Noun + and + Noun नंतर नेहमी Plural Verb वापरतात.
examples: Both Ram and Shyam are intelligent.

wrongRight.wrong: Both Ram and Shyam is intelligent.
wrongRight.right: Both Ram and Shyam are intelligent.

rules.title: Either...Or = Nearest Subject
rules.english: The verb agrees with the nearest subject.
rules.marathi: Verb हे जवळच्या Subject नुसार वापरतात.
examples: Either Ram or his friends are coming.
Either the boys or Ram is coming.

wrongRight.wrong: Either Ram or his friends is coming.
wrongRight.right: Either Ram or his friends are coming.

rules.title: Neither...Nor = Nearest Subject
rules.english: The nearest subject decides the verb.
rules.marathi: जवळचा Subject Verb ठरवतो.
examples: Neither the boys nor Ram is guilty.
Neither Ram nor his friends are guilty.

wrongRight.wrong: Neither Ram nor his friends is guilty.
wrongRight.right: Neither Ram nor his friends are guilty.

rules.title: Not Only...But Also = Nearest Subject
rules.english: The verb agrees with the nearest subject.
rules.marathi: Verb जवळच्या Subject नुसार वापरतात.
examples: Not only Ram but also his friends are coming.
Not only the boys but also Ram is present.

wrongRight.wrong: Not only Ram but also his friends is coming.
wrongRight.right: Not only Ram but also his friends are coming.

rules.title: No Sooner...Than = Past Perfect + Past Indefinite
rules.english: Use Past Perfect followed by Past Indefinite.
rules.marathi: No sooner नंतर Past Perfect आणि नंतर Past Indefinite वापरतात.
examples: No sooner had he arrived than it started raining.

wrongRight.wrong: No sooner did he arrive than it started raining.
wrongRight.right: No sooner had he arrived than it started raining.

rules.title: Hardly / Scarcely...When
rules.english: Hardly/Scarcely + had + V3, followed by When.
rules.marathi: Hardly/Scarcely + had + V3 नंतर When वापरतात, Than नाही.
examples: Hardly had I reached home when it started raining.

wrongRight.wrong: Hardly had I reached home than it started raining.
wrongRight.right: Hardly had I reached home when it started raining.

rules.title: Such...That
rules.english: Such + Noun + that.
rules.marathi: Such + Noun + that या रचनेत वापरतात.
examples: It was such a difficult paper that nobody passed.

rules.title: So...That
rules.english: So + Adjective/Adverb + that.
rules.marathi: So + Adjective/Adverb + that या रचनेत वापरतात.
examples: He was so tired that he slept immediately.

rules.title: Lest = Should / Base Verb
rules.english: After Lest, use Should or the Base Verb; never use 'not'.
rules.marathi: Lest नंतर Should किंवा Base Verb वापरतात, 'not' कधीही वापरत नाहीत.
examples: Study hard lest you should fail.

wrongRight.right: Study hard lest you should fail.

rules.title: Unless = If...Not
rules.english: Unless means If...not; never use a double negative.
rules.marathi: Unless म्हणजे If...not, त्यामुळे Double Negative वापरू नये.
examples: Unless you study, you will fail.

wrongRight.right: Unless you study, you will fail.

rules.title: Until Denotes Time
rules.english: Until shows that an action continues till a point in time.
rules.marathi: Until हा वेळ दर्शवतो, क्रिया एका बिंदूपर्यंत चालू राहते.

rules.title: As Soon As = Immediate Action
rules.english: Shows immediate action right after another action.
rules.marathi: एका क्रियेनंतर लगेच घडणारी क्रिया दर्शवते.
examples: As soon as he arrived, the meeting started.

rules.title: While = Same Time / Contrast
rules.english: Shows simultaneous actions or contrast.
rules.marathi: एकाच वेळी घडणाऱ्या क्रिया किंवा Contrast दर्शवते.
examples: While I was studying, my brother was sleeping.
Ram is hardworking whereas Shyam is lazy.

rules.title: Because vs So
rules.english: Because shows reason; So shows result. Never use both together.
rules.marathi: Because कारण दर्शवते, So परिणाम दर्शवते. दोन्ही एकत्र वापरू नये.
examples: Because he was ill, he stayed home.
He was ill, so he stayed home.

wrongRight.wrong: Because he was ill so he stayed home.
wrongRight.right: Because he was ill, he stayed home.

rules.title: Although / Though = Never With But
rules.english: Never use 'But' together with Although/Though.
rules.marathi: Although / Though सोबत 'But' कधीही वापरू नये.
examples: Although he is poor, he is honest.

wrongRight.wrong: Although he is poor but he is honest.
wrongRight.right: Although he is poor, he is honest.

rules.title: If = First Conditional
rules.english: If + Present tense, followed by Future tense.
rules.marathi: If + Present, नंतर Future वापरतात.
examples: If you study, you will pass.

rules.title: Whether...Or = Alternatives
rules.english: Used when there are alternatives.
rules.marathi: पर्याय दर्शवताना Whether...Or वापरतात.
examples: I don't know whether he will come or not.

rules.title: As If / As Though = Imagination
rules.english: Shows imagination or an unreal situation.
rules.marathi: कल्पना किंवा असत्य परिस्थिती दर्शवते.
examples: He talks as if he knew everything.

goldenRevision: No sooner...than → Past Perfect + Past Indefinite

pyqTraps.wrong: Although he is poor but honest.
pyqTraps.right: Although he is poor, he is honest.

pyqTraps.wrong: Because he was ill so he stayed home.
pyqTraps.right: Because he was ill, he stayed home.

pyqTraps.wrong: No sooner did he arrive than...
pyqTraps.right: No sooner had he arrived than...

pyqTraps.wrong: Either Ram or his friends is...
pyqTraps.right: Either Ram or his friends are...

pyqTraps.wrong: Neither Ram nor his friends is...
pyqTraps.right: Neither Ram nor his friends are...

pyqTraps.wrong: Not only Ram but also his friends is...
pyqTraps.right: Not only Ram but also his friends are...

examStrategy.label: Tier-1
examStrategy.text: Golden Revision + PYQ Traps are sufficient.

examStrategy.label: Tier-2
examStrategy.text: Revise all Correlative Conjunctions and Sentence Improvement Rules.

examStrategy.text: Solve 60–80 Conjunction PYQs.

examStrategy.label: Exam पूर्वी

grammar_topics.finalVerdict: These notes cover nearly 95–100% of the Conjunction syllabus asked in SSC CGL Tier-1 + Tier-2. They are compact (about 6–7 revision pages), PYQ-oriented, and include all major rules, correlative conjunctions, common exam traps, and sentence improvement patterns. Read → Revise → Solve PYQs → Re-revise = Conjunction Chapter Mastered.

grammar_topics.title: Noun
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A noun is the name of a person, place, thing, quality, feeling, or idea.
definition.marathi: व्यक्ती, स्थळ, वस्तू, गुण, भावना किंवा कल्पनेच्या नावाला Noun म्हणतात.

types.name: Proper Noun
types.english: Specific name of a particular person, place, or thing.
types.marathi: विशिष्ट व्यक्ती, स्थळ किंवा वस्तूचे नाव.

types.name: Common Noun
types.english: General name of a person, place, or thing.

types.name: Material Noun
types.english: Name of the substance from which things are made.
types.marathi: ज्या पदार्थापासून वस्तू बनतात त्यांची नावे.

types.name: Abstract Noun
types.english: Name of a quality, feeling, or idea.
types.marathi: गुण, भावना, अवस्था किंवा कल्पना दर्शवणारी नावे.

types.name: Collective Noun
types.english: Name of a group taken as one whole.

countability.name: Uncountable Nouns > Can not be Count
countability.english: Nouns that cannot be counted directly.
countability.question: How much?

rules.title: Uncountable Nouns - Always Singular
rules.marathi: Uncountable nouns नेहमी Singular असतात.
rules.english: Uncountable nouns are always singular.

rules.title: Nouns Always Used in Plural - Always Plural
rules.marathi: हे शब्द नेहमी Plural असतात.

rules.title: Singular Form but Plural Meaning - Actually Plural
rules.marathi: दिसायला Singular पण अर्थाने Plural.

rules.title: Plural Form but Singular Meaning - Singular Form
rules.marathi: दिसायला Plural पण अर्थाने Singular.

rules.title: Same Singular and Plural - Not changed
rules.marathi: Singular आणि Plural दोन्ही सारखे असतात.

rules.title: Change in Meaning After Adding S/ES
rules.marathi: Singular आणि Plural चा अर्थ वेगळा होतो.

rules.title: Noun + Preposition + Same Noun = Singular Verb
rules.marathi: Noun + Preposition + Same Noun असल्यास Singular Verb वापरतात.

rules.title: One of / Each of - Noun Plural
rules.marathi: One of, Each of नंतर Noun Plural येतो.

rules.title: The Number of / A Number of = Plural Noun → Singular Verb/Plural Noun → Plural Verb

subpoints.label: The number of + Plural Noun → Singular Verb
subpoints.example: The number of students is increasing.

subpoints.label: A number of + Plural Noun → Plural Verb
subpoints.example: A number of students are absent.

rules.title: A Pair Of = Verb Singular
rules.marathi: A pair of आल्यास Verb Singular येतो.
examples: A pair of scissors is lying on the table.
A pair of trousers was purchased yesterday.

rules.title: Collective Noun - Group as a unit → Singular Verb / Members acting separately → Plural Verb

subpoints.label: Group as a unit → Singular Verb
subpoints.example: The committee has submitted its report.

subpoints.label: Members acting separately → Plural Verb
subpoints.example: The committee are divided in their opinions.

rules.title: Compound Nouns - Plural use with Main Noun
rules.marathi: Plural मुख्य Noun ला लावतात.

rules.title: Possessive Case (Apostrophe) - Show possession
rules.marathi: मालकी दाखवण्यासाठी ('s) वापरतात.

subsections.title: Proper Nouns Ending in S

grammar_topics.title: Preposition
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A Preposition is a word that shows the relationship between a noun/pronoun and another word in a sentence.
definition.marathi: Sentence मधील Noun/Pronoun आणि इतर शब्दांमधील संबंध दाखवणाऱ्या शब्दाला Preposition म्हणतात.

examples.word: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the chair.

types.name: Preposition of Time
types.english: Shows time.

types.name: Preposition of Place
types.english: Shows place.

types.name: Preposition of Direction
types.english: Shows direction.

types.name: Preposition of Movement
types.english: Shows movement.

types.name: Preposition of Cause/Reason
types.english: Shows cause or reason.

types.name: Preposition of Manner/Instrument
types.english: Shows manner or instrument.

position.english: A preposition usually comes before the noun/pronoun.
position.marathi: सामान्यतः Preposition Noun/Pronoun च्या आधी येतो.
examples: The pen is on the table.

goldenConcept.title: SSC Golden Concept: AT / IN / ON
goldenConcept.english: AT is used for exact time/point, IN for months/years/inside, ON for days/dates/surface.
goldenConcept.marathi: AT -> Exact Time/Point, IN -> Month/Year/Inside, ON -> Day/Date/Surface.

rules.title: AT - Exact Time
rules.english: AT is used for exact time, fixed time, clock time.
rules.marathi: Exact Time, Fixed Time, Clock Time साठी AT वापरतात.

rules.title: IN - Period of Time
rules.english: IN is used for month, year, century, season or larger time period.
rules.marathi: Month, Year, Century, Season किंवा मोठ्या कालावधीसाठी IN वापरतात.

rules.title: ON - Particular Day/Date
rules.english: ON is used for a particular day or date.
rules.marathi: विशिष्ट दिवस किंवा Date साठी ON वापरतात.

rules.title: AT - Exact Point (Place)
rules.english: AT is used for an exact point or specific location.
rules.marathi: एका विशिष्ट Point किंवा Exact Location साठी AT वापरतात.

rules.title: IN - Inside / Enclosed Area
rules.english: IN is used for a large or enclosed space.
rules.marathi: मोठ्या जागेत किंवा आत असल्यास IN वापरतात.

rules.title: ON - Surface
rules.english: ON is used for a surface.
rules.marathi: एखाद्या पृष्ठभागावर असल्यास ON वापरतात.

rules.title: AT vs IN Together (Small vs Large Place)
rules.english: Use AT for a small/specific place and IN for a large place in the same sentence.
rules.marathi: एकाच वाक्यात मोठ्या जागेसाठी IN आणि लहान/Specific जागेसाठी AT वापरतात.
examples: He lives at Karol Bagh in Delhi.
The match was played at Wankhede Stadium in Mumbai.
She works at Infosys in Bengaluru.

rules.title: BY - Doer / Agent
rules.english: BY shows the doer (living agent) in passive voice.
rules.marathi: Passive Voice मध्ये काम करणारी व्यक्ती (Living Agent) दाखवण्यासाठी BY वापरतात.
examples: The letter was written by Ram.
The project was completed by the team.

wrongRight.wrong: The letter was written with Ram.
wrongRight.right: The letter was written by Ram.

rules.title: WITH - Instrument / Tool
rules.english: WITH shows the instrument or non-living tool used to do something.
rules.marathi: काम करण्यासाठी वापरलेले साधन (Instrument), वस्तू (Non-living Thing) दाखवण्यासाठी WITH वापरतात.
examples: He cut the apple with a knife.
The ball was hit with a bat.
Ravana was killed by Rama with an arrow.

wrongRight.wrong: He cut the apple by a knife.
wrongRight.right: He cut the apple with a knife.

rules.title: BESIDE - Next to
rules.english: BESIDE means next to.
rules.marathi: जवळ / शेजारी या अर्थाने BESIDE वापरतात.
examples: The school is beside the temple.

rules.title: BESIDES - In Addition To
rules.english: BESIDES means in addition to.
rules.marathi: याशिवाय / शिवाय / तसेच या अर्थाने BESIDES वापरतात.
examples: Besides riding a bike, he can drive a car.
Besides you, no one helped me.

rules.title: BETWEEN - Two Persons/Things
rules.english: BETWEEN is used for only two persons or things.
rules.marathi: फक्त दोन व्यक्ती किंवा वस्तू असल्यास BETWEEN वापरतात.
examples: Divide the cake between Ram and Shyam.
The match was between India and Australia.

rules.title: AMONG - More Than Two
rules.english: AMONG is used for more than two persons or things.
rules.marathi: दोनपेक्षा जास्त व्यक्ती किंवा वस्तूंमध्ये असल्यास AMONG वापरतात.
examples: He distributed sweets among the students.
Divide the property among the sons.

rules.title: ABOVE - Higher Position
rules.english: ABOVE is used for a higher position without touching.
rules.marathi: फक्त वरच्या Position मध्ये असेल पण Touch नसेल तर ABOVE वापरतात.
examples: The fan is above my head.
The sun is above the clouds.
Write your name above the line.

wrongRight.wrong: The plane flew above the city.
wrongRight.right: The plane flew over the city.

rules.title: OVER - Directly Above / Covering
rules.english: OVER is used for directly above, covering, or movement.
rules.marathi: बरोबर वर, झाकून किंवा Movement असल्यास OVER वापरतात.
examples: The plane flew over the city.
A cloth is spread over the table.
The bridge is over the river.

rules.title: BELOW - Lower Level
rules.english: BELOW is used for a lower level or position.
rules.marathi: एखाद्या Level किंवा Position च्या खाली असल्यास BELOW वापरतात.
examples: The village lies below the hill.

rules.title: UNDER - Directly Beneath
rules.english: UNDER is used for directly beneath or under control.
rules.marathi: थेट खाली किंवा नियंत्रणाखाली असल्यास UNDER वापरतात.
examples: The cat is under the table.

wrongRight.wrong: The cat is below the table.
wrongRight.right: The cat is under the table.

rules.title: SINCE - Starting Point
rules.english: SINCE shows the starting point of time.
rules.marathi: काम कधी सुरू झाले (Point of Time) हे सांगण्यासाठी SINCE वापरतात.

rules.title: FOR - Duration
rules.english: FOR shows the duration or period of time.
rules.marathi: किती वेळ (Period of Time) हे सांगण्यासाठी FOR वापरतात.

rules.title: FROM - General Starting Point
rules.english: FROM shows a starting point in past, present or future.
rules.marathi: भूतकाळ, वर्तमान किंवा भविष्यकाळात सुरुवात दाखवण्यासाठी वापरतात.
examples: The office is open from 9 AM.

rules.title: SINCE - Present Perfect
rules.english: SINCE shows a past starting point in Present Perfect/Perfect Continuous tense.
rules.marathi: Present Perfect/Perfect Continuous मध्ये भूतकाळातील सुरुवात दाखवते.
examples: She has been ill since Monday.

rules.title: DURING - Event
rules.english: DURING is used for an event or period.
rules.marathi: एखाद्या Event किंवा Period च्या दरम्यान असल्यास DURING वापरतात.

rules.title: IN - Time Period
rules.english: IN is used for month, year, season or time period.
rules.marathi: Month, Year, Season किंवा Time Period साठी वापरतात.

rules.title: INTO - Movement
rules.english: INTO shows movement from outside to inside.
rules.marathi: बाहेरून आत जाण्याची हालचाल असल्यास INTO वापरतात.
examples: The cat ran into the house.

rules.title: IN - Position
rules.english: IN shows the position of being inside.
rules.marathi: आत असल्याची स्थिती दर्शवण्यासाठी IN वापरतात.

rules.title: ACROSS - One Side to Another
rules.english: ACROSS shows going from one side to another.
rules.marathi: एका बाजूकडून दुसऱ्या बाजूला जाणे.

rules.title: THROUGH - Inside
rules.english: THROUGH shows going through the inside of an enclosed space.
rules.marathi: एखाद्या बंद जागेच्या आतून जाणे.

rules.title: ALONG - Beside a Road/River
rules.english: ALONG shows moving beside a road, river or coast.
rules.marathi: एखाद्या रस्त्याच्या, नदीच्या किंवा किनाऱ्याच्या बाजूने जाणे.
examples: The children ran along the beach.

rules.title: ROUND vs AROUND
rules.english: ROUND is more common in British English; AROUND is more common in American English, both meaning approximately the same.
rules.marathi: ROUND British English मध्ये अधिक वापरतात, AROUND American English मध्ये अधिक वापरतात.
examples: The earth moves around the sun.

rules.title: TO - Destination
rules.english: TO is used when the destination is definite.
rules.marathi: Destination निश्चित असल्यास TO वापरतात.

rules.title: TOWARDS - Direction
rules.english: TOWARDS is used to show only direction, not a definite destination.
rules.marathi: फक्त दिशा (Direction) दाखवायची असल्यास TOWARDS वापरतात.
examples: The child came towards the gate.

rules.title: OF - Relation / Belonging
rules.english: OF shows relation, ownership, part or quantity.
rules.marathi: संबंध, मालकी, भाग किंवा प्रमाण दाखवण्यासाठी OF वापरतात.

rules.title: OFF - Separation
rules.english: OFF shows separation, moving away, or removing.
rules.marathi: वेगळे होणे, दूर जाणे, काढणे या अर्थाने OFF वापरतात.

rules.title: BY - Before / Deadline
rules.english: BY means before or not later than a given time.
rules.marathi: दिलेल्या वेळेच्या आधी किंवा त्या वेळेपर्यंत.

rules.title: UNTIL - Continuation
rules.english: UNTIL means continuing up to a certain time.
rules.marathi: एखाद्या वेळेपर्यंत सतत.

rules.title: In Spite Of vs Despite
rules.english: Both mean 'although/even though'; Despite is never followed by 'of'.
rules.marathi: दोन्हींचा अर्थ 'असूनही'; Despite नंतर 'of' कधीही वापरत नाही.
examples: In spite of the rain, we played.

rules.title: Because Of vs Due To vs Owing To
rules.english: Because of is general; Due to is formal; Owing to means 'because of a reason'.
rules.marathi: Because of सामान्य कारण; Due to औपचारिक (Formal); Owing to कारणामुळे.
examples: The match was cancelled because of rain.
The delay was due to heavy traffic.
Owing to illness, he was absent.

rules.title: According To
rules.english: According to means 'as stated by'.
rules.marathi: "च्या मते"

rules.title: Contrary To
rules.english: Contrary to means 'opposite to'.
rules.marathi: "च्या विरुद्ध"

rules.title: Prefer To
rules.english: The correct pattern is 'Prefer A to B'.
rules.marathi: योग्य Pattern: Prefer A to B

rules.title: Differ From
rules.english: Use 'differ from', not 'differ than'.
rules.marathi: 'Differ from' वापरतात, 'differ than' नाही.
examples: This book differs from that one.

rules.title: Depend On
rules.english: Use 'depend on'; 'depend upon' is formal but 'depend on' is safer for SSC.
rules.marathi: 'Depend on' वापरतात; Formal English मध्ये 'upon' शक्य आहे, पण SSC मध्ये 'depend on' सुरक्षित.

rules.title: Good At
rules.english: Use 'good at', not 'good in' - a common SSC trap.
rules.marathi: 'Good at' वापरतात, 'Good in' नाही (SSC Trap).

rules.title: Interested In
rules.english: Use 'interested in', not 'interested on'.
rules.marathi: 'Interested in' वापरतात, 'interested on' नाही.

rules.title: Capable Of
rules.english: Use 'capable of', not 'capable to'.
rules.marathi: 'Capable of' वापरतात, 'capable to' नाही.

rules.title: Famous For
rules.english: Use 'famous for', not 'famous of'.
rules.marathi: 'Famous for' वापरतात, 'famous of' नाही.

rules.title: Congratulate On
rules.english: Use 'congratulate on', not 'congratulate for'.
rules.marathi: 'Congratulate on' वापरतात, 'congratulate for' नाही.

rules.title: Object To
rules.english: Use 'object to', not 'object against'.
rules.marathi: 'Object to' वापरतात, 'object against' नाही.

rules.title: Comply With
rules.english: Use 'comply with', not 'comply to'.
rules.marathi: 'Comply with' वापरतात, 'comply to' नाही.

pyqTraps.wrong: The plane flew above the city.
pyqTraps.right: The plane flew over the city.

pyqTraps.wrong: The cat is below the table.
pyqTraps.right: The cat is under the table.

examStrategy.marathi: AT–IN–ON, BY vs WITH, BETWEEN vs AMONG आणि BESIDE vs BESIDES मधून दरवर्षी 1-2 Questions येतात. Golden Revision Page + PYQ Traps पुरेसे आहेत.

grammar_topics.title: Pronoun
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A word used in place of a noun is called a pronoun.
definition.marathi: Noun च्या जागी वापरल्या जाणाऱ्या शब्दाला Pronoun म्हणतात.

types.name: Personal Pronoun
types.english: Pronouns used instead of names of persons.

types.name: Possessive Pronoun
types.english: Pronouns showing possession without a noun.

types.name: Demonstrative Pronoun
types.english: Pronouns used to point out persons or things.
types.marathi: व्यक्ती किंवा वस्तू दाखवण्यासाठी वापरले जाणारे Pronouns.

types.name: Distributive Pronoun
types.english: Refers to persons/things one at a time.
types.marathi: एकावेळी एका व्यक्ती/वस्तूचा उल्लेख करणारे Pronouns.

types.name: Reciprocal Pronoun
types.english: Shows mutual relationship.

types.name: Reflexive Pronoun
types.english: Subject and object are same.

types.name: Emphatic Pronoun
types.english: Used for emphasis.

types.name: Indefinite Pronoun
types.english: Refers to persons/things generally.

types.name: Relative Pronoun
types.english: Connects clauses.

types.name: Interrogative Pronoun
types.english: Used for asking questions.

rules.title: Order Of Pronouns (Positive Sentence) 2-3-1
rules.english: Use 231 order.
rules.marathi: Positive Sentence मध्ये 2-3-1 क्रम वापरतात.
examples: You, he and I have completed the work.

wrongRight.wrong: I, you and he have completed the work.
wrongRight.right: You, he and I have completed the work.

rules.title: Order Of Pronouns (Negative Sentence) 1-2-3
rules.english: Use 123 order.
rules.marathi: Negative किंवा blame sentence मध्ये 1-2-3 क्रम.
examples: I, you and he are responsible for the mistake.

wrongRight.wrong: You, he and I are responsible for the mistake.
wrongRight.right: I, you and he are responsible for the mistake.

rules.title: Each / Every Rule = Singular Pronoun
rules.english: After Each and Every, singular pronouns are generally used.
rules.marathi: Each / Every नंतर सामान्यतः Singular Pronoun.
examples: Each student should perform his duty.

wrongRight.wrong: Every boy must complete their work.
wrongRight.right: Every boy must complete his work.

rules.title: Preposition + Objective Case = Objective Pronoun
rules.english: After a preposition, objective pronouns are used.
rules.marathi: Preposition नंतर Objective Pronoun वापरतात.

rules.title: Let Rule = Objective Pronoun
rules.english: After Let, objective pronouns are used.
rules.marathi: Let नंतर Objective Pronoun वापरतात.

rules.title: Comparison Rule = Subjective Pronoun
rules.english: In formal comparisons, subjective pronouns are often preferred.
rules.marathi: तुलना करताना सामान्यतः Subjective Pronoun वापरतात.
examples: No other employee is as efficient as he.

rules.title: Apostrophe Rule (Its vs It's) = Possessive Pronoun
rules.english: Possessive pronouns do not take apostrophes.
rules.marathi: Possessive Pronouns मध्ये Apostrophe (') वापरत नाहीत.

rules.title: Reflexive Pronoun Agreement = Reflexive Pronoun
rules.english: Reflexive pronouns must agree with their subjects and cannot be used as subjects alone.
rules.marathi: Reflexive Pronoun हे Subject शी जुळले पाहिजे आणि ते एकटे Subject म्हणून वापरता येत नाही.

rules.title: Collective Noun Rule= Singular - One Unit / Plural Pronoun- Divided Members
rules.english: A collective noun used as one unit takes a singular pronoun; if members act separately, use plural.
rules.marathi: Collective Noun एक गट म्हणून असेल तर Singular Pronoun, सदस्य स्वतंत्र असल्यास Plural Pronoun.

rules.title: Same Case Rule - use And = Same Case (Subjective/Objective)
rules.english: Pronouns joined by 'and' should remain in the same case.
rules.marathi: And ने जोडलेले Pronouns एकाच Case (Subjective/Objective) मध्ये असावेत.
examples: The teacher praised him and me.

wrongRight.wrong: The teacher praised he and I.
wrongRight.right: The teacher praised him and me.

rules.title: Who vs Whom Rule = Subjective vs Objective Pronoun
rules.english: Who acts as subject (He/She/They), Whom acts as object (Him/Her/Them).
rules.marathi: Who चा वापर Subject म्हणून तर Whom चा वापर Object म्हणून होतो.
examples: The boy who won the race is my friend.
The man whom I met was helpful.

rules.title: That Rule (Superlative & Mixed Antecedents)
rules.english: Use 'that' after superlative degrees and when a person + thing/animal are combined.
rules.marathi: Superlative Degree नंतर आणि व्यक्ती + वस्तू/प्राणी एकत्र आल्यास 'that' वापरतात.
examples: Virat is the best player that India has produced.
The man and the dog that we saw belonged to our neighbour.

wrongRight.wrong: The man and the dog who we saw.
wrongRight.right: The man and the dog that we saw.

rules.title: That / Those Repetition Rule = That of sigular / Those of Plural
rules.english: Use 'that of' for singular and 'those of' for plural nouns to avoid repetition.
rules.marathi: Noun ची पुनरावृत्ती टाळण्यासाठी Singular साठी that of आणि Plural साठी those of वापरतात.
examples: The climate of Pune is better than that of Mumbai.
The rivers of India are larger than those of America.

wrongRight.wrong: The salary of a manager is higher than a clerk.
wrongRight.right: The salary of a manager is higher than that of a clerk.

rules.title: Reciprocal Pronouns (Each other / One another) = two entities/ More than two entities
rules.english: Use 'each other' for two entities, and 'one another' for more than two.
rules.marathi: दोन व्यक्ती/वस्तूंसाठी Each other आणि दोनपेक्षा जास्तीसाठी One another वापरतात.
examples: Ram and Shyam help each other.

wrongRight.wrong: The two sisters love one another.
wrongRight.right: The two sisters love each other.

rules.title: One -> One's Rule
rules.english: When the subject is 'One', its possessive form must be 'One's'.
rules.marathi: Subject 'One' असल्यास त्याचा Possessive Form 'One's' असावा.
examples: One must perform one's duty sincerely.

rules.title: Either of / Neither of Structural Rule = plural noun/pronoun + Singular Verb/ Pluaral Verb
rules.english: Either of / Neither of takes a plural noun/pronoun but always requires a singular verb.
rules.marathi: Either of / Neither of नंतर Plural Noun/Pronoun येतो, पण Verb नेहमी Singular असतो.
examples: Neither of the boys is absent.

wrongRight.wrong: Neither of the boys are absent.
wrongRight.right: Neither of the boys is absent.

rules.title: It is + Subjective Case
rules.english: Pronouns following a form of the verb 'to be' (is/was/were) must be in the subjective case.
rules.marathi: To Be च्या रूपांनंतर (is/was/were) नेहमी Subjective Case वापरतात.
examples: If I were he, I would accept the offer.

wrongRight.wrong: It is me who solved the problem.
wrongRight.right: It is I who solved the problem.

rules.title: Gerund + Possessive Adjective
rules.english: Use a possessive adjective before a gerund (v+ing acting as a noun).
rules.marathi: Gerund (v+ing) च्या आधी नेहमी Possessive Adjective (my, his, your) वापरतात.
examples: He insisted on my staying there.

wrongRight.wrong: I didn't like him coming late.
wrongRight.right: I didn't like his coming late.

rules.title: But (Except) Preposition Rule = objective pronoun
rules.english: When 'but' means 'except', it acts as a preposition and takes an objective pronoun.
rules.marathi: जेव्हा 'but' चा अर्थ 'शिवाय/खेरीज' (except) असतो, तेव्हा ते Preposition असते व त्यानंतर Objective Case येते.

grammar_topics.title: Question Tags
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: A Question Tag is a short question added at the end of a statement to confirm information or seek agreement, formed using an auxiliary verb + subject pronoun.
definition.marathi: Statement च्या शेवटी माहिती Confirm करण्यासाठी किंवा Agreement मिळवण्यासाठी जोडलेल्या छोट्या Question ला Question Tag म्हणतात (Auxiliary Verb + Subject Pronoun).
definition.structure: Main Statement , + Auxiliary(opposite polarity) + Subject Pronoun ?

examples.word: It's a good day, isn't it?
You haven't seen my glasses, have you?
Let's go to the movies, shall we?
She rarely attends class, does she?

rules.title: Positive-Negative Rule
rules.english: If the main statement is positive, the tag is negative. If the main statement is negative, the tag is positive.
rules.marathi: जर Statement Positive असेल तर Tag Negative असतो, आणि Statement Negative असेल तर Tag Positive असतो.
examples: The cat is sleeping on the couch, isn't it?
You haven't seen my glasses, have you?

wrongRight.wrong: The cat is sleeping on the couch, is it?
wrongRight.right: The cat is sleeping on the couch, isn't it?

wrongRight.wrong: You haven't seen my glasses, haven't you?
wrongRight.right: You haven't seen my glasses, have you?

rules.title: Negative Words Rule
rules.english: Certain words (hardly, scarcely, barely, rarely, seldom, few, little, none, nothing, neither) make a sentence negative in meaning, so the tag becomes positive.
rules.marathi: hardly, scarcely, barely, rarely, seldom, few, little, none, nothing, neither हे शब्द Sentence ला अर्थाने Negative बनवतात, त्यामुळे Tag Positive येतो.
examples: He barely knows the truth, does he?
They've hardly tried their best, have they?
He hardly ever misses a class, does he?

wrongRight.wrong: He barely knows the truth, doesn't he?
wrongRight.right: He barely knows the truth, does he?

wrongRight.wrong: They've hardly tried their best, haven't they?
wrongRight.right: They've hardly tried their best, have they?

rules.title: Little/Few Family Rule
rules.english: Little/Few (negligible amount) are negative and take a positive tag. A little/A few (at least something) are positive and take a negative tag. The little/The few (remaining) are positive and take a negative tag.
rules.marathi: Little/Few (नगण्य) Negative असतात -> Positive Tag. A little/A few (काहीतरी) Positive असतात -> Negative Tag. The little/The few (उरलेले) Positive असतात -> Negative Tag.
examples: I have little hope for success, do I?
She ate a few of the cookies, didn't she?

wrongRight.wrong: I have little hope for success, don't I?
wrongRight.right: I have little hope for success, do I?

wrongRight.wrong: She ate a few of the cookies, did she?
wrongRight.right: She ate a few of the cookies, didn't she?

rules.title: Let's Rule
rules.english: Let's always takes the tag 'shall we?' regardless of the main verb.
rules.marathi: Let's नंतर नेहमी 'shall we?' हा Tag येतो, Main Verb कोणताही असो.
examples: Let's go to the movies, shall we?
Let's bake a cake, shall we?
Let's go for a walk, shall we?

wrongRight.wrong: Let's go to the movies, should we?
wrongRight.right: Let's go to the movies, shall we?

wrongRight.wrong: Let's bake a cake, will we?
wrongRight.right: Let's bake a cake, shall we?

rules.title: Auxiliary Contraction Rule
rules.english: Use the correct negative contraction of the auxiliary verb in the tag (e.g. is not -> isn't, am not -> aren't I, have not -> haven't).
rules.marathi: Tag मध्ये Auxiliary Verb च्या योग्य Negative Contraction चा वापर करा (उदा. is not -> isn't, am not -> aren't I, have not -> haven't).
examples: She doesn't like the dress, does she?
I'm not sure about this, am I?
I am your friend, aren't I?

wrongRight.wrong: I'm not sure about this, isn't I?
wrongRight.right: I'm not sure about this, am I?

wrongRight.wrong: I am your friend, isn't I?
wrongRight.right: I am your friend, aren't I?

rules.title: Indefinite Pronoun Rule
rules.english: Everybody/Everyone/Somebody/Someone/Nobody/Anybody take a plural tag pronoun (they), even though the verb agreement with the pronoun stays singular.
rules.marathi: Everybody/Everyone/Somebody/Someone/Nobody/Anybody या Indefinite Pronouns नंतर Tag मध्ये Plural Pronoun (they) वापरतात.
examples: Everybody loves the new song, don't they?
Nobody has seen that movie, have they?
Someone has taken my book, haven't they?

grammar_topics.title: Subject Verb Agreement (SVA)
grammar_topics.subtitle: SSC CGL Tier 1 + Tier 2 Complete Notes

definition.english: Subject Verb Agreement means the verb must agree with the subject in number and person.
definition.marathi: Subject आणि Verb यांच्यात Number (Singular/Plural) आणि Person चा मेळ असणे म्हणजे Subject Verb Agreement.

rules.title: AND Rule = Plural Verb
rules.marathi: दोन Singular Subjects AND ने जोडले असतील तर Verb Plural येतो.

rules.title: Same Person / Same Thing = Singular Verb
rules.marathi: दोन Nouns एकाच व्यक्ती किंवा वस्तूसाठी वापरले असतील तर Singular Verb.
examples: The Secretary and Principal is coming.
The poet and philosopher was honored.

rules.title: Each / Every + And = Singular Verb
rules.marathi: Each किंवा Every असल्यास Singular Verb.
examples: Every boy and girl was present.
Each man and woman was invited.

wrongRight.wrong: Every boy and girl were present.
wrongRight.right: Every boy and girl was present.

rules.title: Each / Either / Neither = Singular Verb
rules.marathi: Each, Either, Neither नेहमी Singular Verb घेतात.
examples: Each of the boys is present.
Either of the roads leads to Pune.
Neither of the girls has arrived.

rules.title: Either...Or / Neither...Nor = Nearest Subject
rules.marathi: Verb Nearest Subject नुसार येतो.
examples: Either Ram or his friends are coming.
Either the boys or Ram is coming.
Neither Ram nor his friends are ready.
Neither the boys nor Ram is ready.

rules.title: Not Only...But Also = Nearest Subject
rules.marathi: Verb Nearest Subject नुसार येतो.
examples: Not only Ram but also his friends are present.
Not only the boys but also Ram is present.

rules.title: Along With / As Well As = First Subject
rules.marathi: Verb First Subject नुसार येतो.
examples: Ram along with his friends is coming.
The teacher as well as students was present.

rules.title: Many A / More Than One = Singular Noun + Singular Verb
rules.marathi: Singular Noun + Singular Verb
examples: More than one student has passed.

rules.title: A Number Of / The Number Of = Plural Noun + Plural Verb / Plural Noun + Singular Verb
examples: A number of students are absent.
The number of students is increasing.

rules.title: One Of = Plural Noun + Singular Verb
rules.marathi: One Of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb
examples: One of the boys is absent.
One of the books was lost.

rules.title: All / Some / Most / Half = Object Based
rules.marathi: Object नुसार Verb येतो.
examples: Half of the money is spent.
Half of the students are absent.

rules.title: Collective Nouns = One Unit / Members = Singular/Plural
rules.marathi: Group म्हणून वापरल्यास Singular, Members वेगळे असल्यास Plural.
examples: The committee has taken its decision.

rules.title: News / Physics / Mathematics = Singular Verb
rules.marathi: Plural दिसतात पण Singular Verb घेतात.

rules.title: Distance / Time / Money = Singular Verb
rules.marathi: एक Unit मानल्यास Singular Verb.
examples: Ten kilometers is a long distance.
Ten years is a long time.

rules.title: There / Here = Actual Subject
rules.marathi: Verb Actual Subject नुसार येतो.
examples: There is a book on the table.
There are books on the table.

rules.title: Titles of Books / Movies = Singular
rules.marathi: Title Singular मानला जातो.
examples: The Ramayana is a great epic.
Gulliver's Travels is a famous book.

rules.title: Pair Nouns = Plural Verb
rules.marathi: Scissors, Trousers, Spectacles हे Plural Verb घेतात.

definition.english: A Tense is the form of a verb that indicates the time of an action, event, or state.
definition.marathi: क्रिया कोणत्या काळात घडते (वर्तमान, भूत किंवा भविष्य), हे दर्शवणाऱ्या Verb च्या रूपाला Tense म्हणतात.

types.name: Past Tense
types.english: Action happened in past.

types.name: Future Tense
types.english: Action will happen in future.

parts.title: Present Tenses

definition.english: Present Tense tells about present action, habit, routine, universal truth, scheduled event, current action, recently completed action, or action continuing from past till present.
definition.marathi: Present Tense वर्तमान क्रिया, सवय, दिनक्रम, सत्य, वेळापत्रक किंवा भूतकाळापासून सुरू असलेली क्रिया दर्शवतो.

tenseTypes.name: Simple Present Tense

definition.english: Used for habit, daily routine, universal truth, facts, permanent situations, newspaper headlines, and scheduled events.
definition.marathi: नेहमी होणारी क्रिया, सवय, सत्य, दिनक्रम किंवा कायमची गोष्ट दर्शवण्यासाठी वापरला जातो.

examples: The sun rises in the east.

rules.english: He/She/It/Any Singular Noun takes V1 + s/es.
rules.marathi: He/She/It किंवा Singular Noun नंतर V1+s/es वापरतात.

rules.title: I / We / You / They : Use only V1
rules.english: Use only V1 with I, We, You, They.
rules.marathi: I/We/You/They नंतर फक्त V1 वापरतात.

rules.title: Universal Truth : Always use Simple Present for universal truths.
rules.english: Always use Simple Present for universal truths.
rules.marathi: सार्वत्रिक सत्यासाठी नेहमी Simple Present वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: Earth is revolving around the Sun.

rules.title: Habit / Routine : Daily activities use Simple Present.
rules.english: Daily activities use Simple Present.
rules.marathi: दैनंदिन क्रियांसाठी Simple Present वापरतात.
examples: I get up at 6 AM every day.

wrongRight.wrong: She is drinking coffee every morning.

rules.title: Newspaper Headlines : Simple Present
rules.english: Simple Present is used in newspaper headlines.
rules.marathi: वृत्तपत्राच्या मथळ्यांमध्ये Simple Present वापरतात.

rules.title: Scheduled Events : Used for timetable, train, flight etc.
rules.english: Simple Present is used for fixed schedules such as timetables, trains, flights, buses, exams, and programs.
rules.marathi: वेळापत्रक, ट्रेन, फ्लाईट, बस, परीक्षा, कार्यक्रम अशा निश्चित वेळापत्रकासाठी Simple Present वापरतात.

wrongRight.wrong: The train will leave at 8 AM.
The flight will arrive tomorrow morning.

tenseTypes.sscPyqRule: After Every day, Always, Usually, Generally, Often, Never → Use Simple Present

definition.english: Action happening right now or around the present time.
definition.marathi: सध्या सुरू असलेली क्रिया.

rules.title: Be Verb Agreement : I → am, He/She/It → is, We/You/They → are.
rules.english: I → am, He/She/It → is, We/You/They → are.
rules.marathi: I→am, He/She/It→is, We/You/They→are.

rules.title: Temporary Action
rules.english: Used for temporary actions.
rules.marathi: तात्पुरत्या क्रियेसाठी वापरतात.
examples: I am living in Pune these days.
She is working from home this week.
They are staying with their relatives for a few days.

wrongRight.wrong: I live in Pune these days.
wrongRight.right: I am living in Pune these days.

rules.title: Changing Situation
rules.english: Used for a changing situation.
rules.marathi: बदलत्या परिस्थितीसाठी वापरतात.

wrongRight.right: The population is increasing rapidly nowadays.

rules.title: Fixed Near Future
rules.english: Used for personal arrangements in the near future.
rules.marathi: जवळच्या भविष्यातील ठरलेल्या नियोजनासाठी वापरतात.
examples: We are leaving for Delhi next week.

rules.title: Repeated Annoying Action

rules.marathi: Always + Present Continuous त्रास/चीड दर्शवते.

rules.english: He/She/It/Singular → Has; I/We/You/They/Plural → Have.
rules.marathi: He/She/It/Singular → Has; I/We/You/They/Plural → Have.

rules.marathi: आत्ताच पूर्ण झालेल्या आणि ज्याचा परिणाम वर्तमानाशी संबंधित आहे अशा क्रियेसाठी Present Perfect वापरतात.

rules.title: Experience
rules.english: Used to describe life experiences without mentioning a specific past time.
rules.marathi: विशिष्ट वेळ न सांगता जीवनातील अनुभव दर्शवण्यासाठी Present Perfect वापरतात.
examples: She has never seen the Taj Mahal.
Have you ever travelled by air?

rules.title: Yet: used only in negative and interrogative sentences.
rules.english: Yet is used only in negative and interrogative sentences.
rules.marathi: Yet फक्त Negative आणि Interrogative वाक्यांमध्ये वापरतात.
examples: I haven't finished my work yet.

wrongRight.wrong: I have yet finished my work.
wrongRight.right: I haven't finished my work yet.

rules.title: Already
rules.english: Already is generally used in affirmative sentences to show an action happened earlier than expected.
rules.marathi: Already मुख्यतः Positive वाक्यांमध्ये अपेक्षेपेक्षा आधी पूर्ण झालेली क्रिया दर्शवण्यासाठी वापरतात.
examples: They have already reached the station.

wrongRight.wrong: I haven't already finished the work.
wrongRight.right: I haven't finished the work yet.

rules.title: Since / For : Point of Time
rules.english: Since is used with a point of time, and For is used with a period of time. They are commonly used with Present Perfect Continuous, but may also be used with Present Perfect.
rules.marathi: Since वेळेच्या बिंदूसाठी (Point of Time) आणि For कालावधीसाठी (Period of Time) वापरतात. हे सामान्यतः Present Perfect Continuous सोबत येतात, परंतु Present Perfect सोबतही वापरले जाऊ शकतात.
examples: I have lived in Pune for five years.
He has been studying for three hours.
They have been living here since January.

wrongRight.wrong: I have been living here since five years.
wrongRight.right: I have been living here for five years.

sscPyqTrap2.right: I have just completed my homework.

tenseTypes.name: Present Perfect Continuous Tense

definition.english: Action started in the past and is still continuing.
definition.marathi: भूतकाळात सुरू झालेली आणि अजूनही सुरू असलेली क्रिया.

examples: I have been studying for three hours.
She has been living here since 2020.

rules.title: Since = Point of Time
rules.english: Since is used with a point of time (2019, Monday, Morning, 5 PM, January, Childhood).
rules.marathi: Since वेळेच्या बिंदूसाठी वापरतात.
examples: She has been studying since Monday.

wrongRight.wrong: She has been studying for Monday.
wrongRight.right: She has been studying since Monday.

rules.title: For = Period of Time
rules.english: For is used with a period of time (2 hours, 5 years, 3 months, 10 days, Long time).
rules.marathi: For कालावधीसाठी वापरतात.
examples: He has been waiting for two hours.
They have been working for five years.

wrongRight.wrong: He has been waiting since two hours.
wrongRight.right: He has been waiting for two hours.

rules.title: Action Must Continue
rules.english: The action must still continue.
rules.marathi: क्रिया अजूनही सुरू असणे आवश्यक.
examples: I have been working here since 2023.
She has been studying for three hours.
They have been living in Pune since 2020.

wrongRight.wrong: I have been working here since 2023, but I left the job last year.
wrongRight.right: I worked here from 2023 to last year.

rules.title: Duration + Present
rules.english: Duration expressions indicate Present Perfect Continuous.
rules.marathi: कालावधी दर्शवणारे शब्द Present Perfect Continuous दर्शवतात.
examples: I have been waiting for two hours.
She has been teaching since morning.
They have been playing all day.

wrongRight.wrong: I am waiting for two hours.
wrongRight.right: I have been waiting for two hours.
She has been teaching since morning.

goldenRevision: has/have been + V-ing → Started in Past & Continuing

pyqTraps.wrong: She has been living here for Monday.
pyqTraps.right: She has been living here since Monday.
